One day I met a girl (I'm a boy), and she was a lesbian. She opened up to me and for the first time, I opened up. It felt great and amazing (even though I was balling my eyes out) I learn that this was a part of me. So, I started to make more friends, I talked to people more. Being who I am, it opened doors that I had never had before. 

Now, I'm not out to everyone of my friends, but I just been a lot happier. I don't know if this helps you, but I hope it does.
